Dubs Mint Menus — menu logic port study
Original author: Dubwise
Workshop: https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=1446523594
Repository: https://github.com/Dubwise56/Dubs-Mint-Menus
Input: user-provided 1.7/Assemblies/DubsMintMenus.dll
SHA-256: 155b7762c1fb9ff927d7c5d9c561d97baf0950b34e91e0e55e8ec9180707ae2f

MenuLogic/MintMenuLogic.cs adapts the search predicates, stable nullable-stat ordering
and pinned-category ordering inspected with ILSpy 9.1.0.7988. Godot controls and
NoDwarf definition adapters are separate implementations. No original DLL or
textures are bundled in the game. Decompiled inspection files remain in .local.

The supplied package contained no license file. This notice records provenance,
not a grant of redistribution rights. Resolve permission before distributing
third-party-derived implementation beyond this private development copy.
